entries.remarks: Agreement terms 1: Party 1 provides power/steam to party 2
Agreement terms 2: Party 1 prioritizes own plant usage, sells surplus to party 2
Agreement terms 4: Pricing based on production cost and market rates
Agreement terms 5: Payments within 30 days from end of billing period
Agreement terms 6: Supply should be constant; liability disclaimer for outages
Agreement terms 7: Continuous supply unless mutually agreed otherwise
Agreement terms 8: 10 year duration from start date
Agreement terms 9: Point of delivery at factory gate, costs/maintenance borne by party 2
Agreement terms 10: Meters to be installed by party 1
Agreement terms 11: Modifications by mutual consent
